A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same BSI research, with readable text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–F. The revised layout and removal of v2's checklist do not prevent reliable comparison.

before.justification: V2 reports original ImageNet32 and CIFAR10 experiments, including BPD, FID, sampling-step comparisons, and ELBO analyses in Section 6.

after.justification: V3 retains original empirical results and adds ImageNet64 evaluation and controlled parameter studies in Sections 6.1 and 6.3.

M1.justification: Algorithms 1–3, the prior, default ELBO objective, preconditioning, and feature construction remain unchanged. Appendix A.3 provides a theoretical interpretation of sampling; the architecture and finite-loss studies evaluate variants without revising the proposed default method.

E1.justification: V3 adds generation and likelihood evaluation on 64×64 ImageNet images while retaining ImageNet32 and CIFAR10. This extends image-resolution coverage within the existing natural-image domain.

E2.justification: BFN and VDM remain the comparators in the corresponding ImageNet32 and CIFAR10 experiments. The added ImageNet64 and ImageNet32 U-Net comparisons use the same comparator set.

E3.justification: V3 introduces ImageNet64 evaluation with DiT-L-4 trained for 1 million steps and controlled ImageNet32 studies using a 100,000-step budget. These vary architecture, initial precision, finite-step training objectives, and evaluation step counts. The original benchmark protocols remain substantially unchanged.

E4.justification: New Section 6.3 tests the identity approximation underlying importance sampling, architecture dependence, initial-precision sensitivity, and finite- versus infinite-step training (Table 3 and Figures 6–8). Figure 3's sampling-step analysis changes from ImageNet32 to ImageNet64; the existing ELBO-convergence and variance-reduction analyses remain.

E5.justification: Both versions report ImageNet standard deviations over three seeds, a single CIFAR10 training run, and Monte Carlo uncertainty for ELBO convergence. Added results extend uncertainty reporting without documenting a changed statistical estimation procedure or increased repeated-run count.

E6.justification: The ImageNet32 and CIFAR10 table values are retained. New ImageNet64 results report BSI at 3.218 BPD/30.1 FID, BFN at 3.222/38.2, and VDM at 3.228/35.2. V3 also adds U-Net and parameter-study findings and replaces Figure 3 with ImageNet64 results; these are additional settings, not same-setting performance changes.

T1.justification: New Appendix A.3 derives a stochastic-interpolant representation, velocity and score fields, an SDE, and its sampling relationship to BSI (Equations 32–42). The existing ELBO and preconditioning proofs are retained. The new Equation 36 has a target inconsistency that undermines its claimed loss equivalence as written.

C1.justification: The abstract replaces CIFAR10 with ImageNet64 in its equivalent-likelihood claim, although CIFAR10 results remain elsewhere. The central Bayesian-generation contribution, BFN special-case claim, and ImageNet32 sample-quality claim retain their meaning.

C2.justification: V3 substantially expands interpretation of design choices, explaining sampling-budget-dependent initial-precision tradeoffs, architecture-independent benefits, and the rationale for infinite-step training. Appendix A.3 adds qualifications concerning finite precision and the difference between exact Bayesian updates and SDE discretization.

D1.justification: Appendix E adds ImageNet32 U-Net and ImageNet64 DiT-L-4 configurations, associated batch/hardware information, and the parameter-study budget. Existing implementation information and the code link remain. V2's separate dataset-license and access statements are removed.

R1.justification: Appendix A.3 substantially extends positioning beyond BFN and diffusion models by relating BSI to stochastic interpolants and distinguishing their updates and endpoints. Albergo et al. and Rissanen et al. are newly cited. The Lewis reference's publication update represents the same previously cited work.

P1.justification: The existing research narrative and section sequence are largely retained, with local explanatory, abstract, affiliation, and acknowledgment edits. Section 6.3 and Appendix A.3 are inserted, while the Licenses section and NeurIPS checklist are removed; most retained prose is not extensively rewritten.

P2.justification: V3 adopts a two-column main text and references, expands Table 2, adds analysis figures and configuration tables, and reorganizes displays. The CIFAR10 table moves into Appendix E. The original generated-sample grid is retained as Figure 9 rather than Figure 6.

improvement.justification: V2 lacked direct tests of architecture dependence, initial-precision tradeoffs, and finite-step training. V3's controlled studies and ImageNet64 evaluation substantially strengthen support for the method and its design choices. These gains outweigh the removed license disclosures and a localized flaw in Appendix A.3: Equation 36 uses the belief μ instead of the data target x, so its claimed equivalence to the denoising ELBO needs correction.
